Start date: 1017-05-12 (YYYY-MM-DD format).  
31 weeks = 31 × 7 = 217 days.  
Add 2 more days → total subtract 219 days.  

1017 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400 → not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
Days in months before May 12 in 1017: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30 → total 120 days before May 12.  
May 12 is day 132 of year (120 + 12).  

Subtract 219 days from day 132: 132 − 219 = −87 days.  
Go into previous year 1016 (leap year: divisible by 4 and 400 rule? 1016/4=254, 1016/400=2.54 → not divisible by 400, but Gregorian rule: years divisible by 4 are leap unless divisible by 100 but not by 400; 1016 not divisible by 100 → leap).  
Days in 1016 after −87: 366 − 87 = 279th day of 1016.  

279th day: Jan 31, Feb 29, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30 → sum:  
Jan–Aug: 31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31=244 days.  
279 − 244 = 35 → into September: September 35? That’s wrong, check: 244 days up to Aug 31.  
279 − 244 = 35 → means 35th day of September = October 5.  

Thus 279th day = October 5, 1016.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1016-10-05
